_note: Served only by POST /api/pricing-access with the right PRICING_ACCESS_CODE (backend/routes/pricing-access.js); never shipped in the public site. Figures from docs/DeftBrain pricing and sales model.xlsx (Tiers sheet, 2026-11-26): cost at $100/hour + model cost at 5% of people served a year, 40% margin, rounded to $100.
notes: People served means your library's service-area population, your credit union's members, your enrolled students or your employees.
The pilot is 90 days: the setup fee plus a quarter of the yearly fee. It is credited in full if you continue.
Consortia: one contract for every member, at 30% off each member's yearly fee.
There are no per-person fees and no accounts to count. Everyone you serve can use DeftBrain; the public site stays free.
